siobac 1.0.1

- Clarified usage scenarios and onboarding instructions in the documentation.
- Added clear descriptions of the three main workflow paths: being reachable, reaching out, and discovering people.
- Detailed command groups with concise explanations and safety/consent checks.
- Updated owner-facing interaction guidelines to focus on language, privacy, and human-centric communication.
- Expanded reference instructions for first-time setup and safe operation on specific platforms.
